conclusions: Optional probe pacing operates per actual transport post, preserving default0 shape and100logical/90second bounds; remaining-time clamp and final checkpoint reject late results.
HTTP401/403/429 and classified JSONRPC rate limit stop further same-endpoint transport, preserving first refusal and unrelated endpoint evaluations.
Bounded cause traversal is cycle-safe; missing canonical hash cannot be relabeled pass by rate/timeouts.
Indexer range reduction stops on known global/terminal causes, retaining opaque provider-range and413 reduction; downstream ancestry/chronology/confirmation/atomic ingestion proofs are unchanged.
documentation_precision: Indexer.reconcile can legitimately commit an authenticated rollback before a later refused fetch. Guarantee no new ingestion or cursor advance from the failed fetch, not absolute no database change for every failed step.
